config.label: Base URL of the TriliumNext instance, e
config.description: Base URL of the TriliumNext instance, e.g. http://localhost:8080

config.label: ETAPI token
config.description: ETAPI token. Required unless TRILIUM_PASSWORD is set. Create one in Trilium under Options → ETAPI.

config.label: Alternative to TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN — BrainLLM mints a token on first start and caches it beside brainllm
config.description: Alternative to TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN — BrainLLM mints a token on first start and caches it beside brainllm.json.

config.label: core (default) exposes the 39 brain-aware tools; full additionally exposes the 33 raw ETAPI tools
config.description: core (default) exposes the 39 brain-aware tools; full additionally exposes the 33 raw ETAPI tools.

config.label: IANA timezone used to stamp dated notes, e
config.description: IANA timezone used to stamp dated notes, e.g. Africa/Johannesburg. Defaults to the host timezone.

config.label: Enables the OAuth 2
config.description: Enables the OAuth 2.1 / CIMD endpoints required by claude.ai and other hosted Claude surfaces. This is the password entered on the consent screen when authorizing a client.

config.label: Override for the public origin when a proxy rewrites Host
config.description: Override for the public origin when a proxy rewrites Host. Must exactly match the URL entered in the client.
